facts.text: The authored practice shows blue attackers moving toward the right-hand goal and red defenders tracking them.
At the pass, the blue attacker is nearer the goal line than both the ball and the second-last red defender.
Being in an offside position by itself is not an offence; the player must become involved in active play.
